owner_and_team.why_started: Founded on the belief that every car deserves proper protection rather than a quick wax that washes away. Identified a gap for a professional, controlled-environment car protection studio in Adelaide's inner north. The Klemzig workshop provides the controlled environment quality car protection demands — every vehicle is worked on indoors, under specialist lighting, with climate control — on the principle that application conditions matter as much as the product itself.

reference_portfolio.volume_vendor_conflict: The SE Ranking record stores 'ceramic coating adelaide' at 10/mo and 'paint protection adelaide' at 20/mo. Google Ads Keyword Planner (preflight probe, 2026-07-27) returns 'ceramic coating adelaide' at 720/mo HIGH competition ($1.30–$10.25) and 'window tinting adelaide' at 1,000/mo MEDIUM — a ~72x disagreement on the same term. Treat the ADG stored volumes as stale or match-type-narrowed, NOT as evidence the head terms lack demand. The zero-volume pattern is real for suburb terms only. Phase 3a must cross-validate head-term volume against Google Ads and should not inherit SE Ranking's figures for the 4 general slots.

Consistent quality standard regardless of vehicle — every job completed to the same 5-star standard, daily driver or prestige vehicle
Fully controlled indoor workshop environment — all work performed indoors at Klemzig with specialist lighting and climate control, eliminating dust, wind and weather variability
Professional-grade, warranted products only — industry-leading brands trusted by prestige car dealers, no shortcuts or inferior substitutes
Transparent, honest pricing — detailed quote before any work begins, no hidden fees

ideal_customer: Car owners across greater Adelaide — particularly the inner-north suburbs — who want to genuinely protect and preserve their vehicle's value. Range from everyday drivers tired of temporary solutions like wax, through to prestige and performance vehicle owners demanding the highest standard of paint protection. They value quality, transparency and honest pricing, and want the assurance of a professional, controlled environment using industry-leading products.

commercial.pricing_structure: Free, no-obligation quotes for all services. Every vehicle assessed individually with a detailed quote before work begins — no hidden fees. Quotes typically returned within 24 hours. Services bookable standalone or as combined packages. No specific pricing figures published on the website — quoted per vehicle by size, condition and services required.
commercial.insurance: Client answered 'Full covered insurance'. No policy types or sums insured supplied — insufficient detail for any trust-signal claim.
commercial.certifications: Authorised partner of GYEON (ceramic coatings), XPEL (PPF), SunTek (PPF and window tint), 3M (PPF and window film) and LLumar (window film). Client explicitly states no trade licences, ISO certifications or other formal accreditations.
commercial.compliance: Complies with South Australian road-legal window tinting regulations — front windscreen minimum 75% VLT, front side windows minimum 35% VLT, no legal minimum on rear side and rear windows. All tinting installations are SA road-legal. No other industry codes or safety standards claimed.

mission: To help Adelaide car owners protect and preserve their vehicle's value through professional-grade ceramic coating, paint protection film, paint correction and window tinting — applied in a controlled workshop environment with honest pricing and no shortcuts.
